description.value: Buy-Low Foods is a full-service supermarket chain operated under the Pattison Food Group, with this location in Surrey's Whalley neighbourhood. It offers a broad range of groceries under both national brands and the chain's own Western Family and Only Goodness private labels. The store carries a loyalty rewards program (More Rewards) redeemable for groceries and other perks, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.
